findings.title: Redundant path normalization after existing path handling
findings.body: The new line `path = path.rstrip("/")` normalizes the path after the existing path handling logic (lines 210–212) that already ensures the path ends with a directory. This is redundant and can be removed to simplify the code.

findings.title: Comment for shared cookie logic is misleading
findings.body: The comment `# Send shared cookie` on line 266 suggests that only shared cookies are being sent, but the code actually sends all cookies that match the empty domain and path (i.e., shared cookies). This comment is misleading and should be updated to reflect the actual behavior.

findings.title: Unclear variable naming in cookie filtering logic
findings.body: The variable `cookies` is assigned the result of `itertools.chain.from_iterable(...)`, but its name does not clearly indicate that it represents a flattened collection of cookies from all domain-path pairs. Renaming it to `matching_cookies` or similar would improve readability.

findings.title: Comment for edge case handling is unclear
findings.body: The comment `# Skip edge case when the cookie has a trailing slash but request doesn't.` on line 299 does not clearly explain why this edge case is being skipped. A more descriptive comment would help maintainers understand the rationale behind this logic.

summary.problem: The PR introduces minor readability issues and redundant logic in the cookie jar implementation.
summary.done_well: The changes improve path handling and cookie filtering logic, and the code remains clean and functional. The use of itertools for domain and path matching is efficient and well-structured.
